summary.text: Josh Carlson is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 43, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Lafayette Parish. First elected in 2023, Josh Carlson sits on the Civil Law and Procedure, Education, and Retirement committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Josh Carlson's occupation as IT consulting, with a B.S. in business administration from the University of Louisiana at Lafayette.

The House page lists Josh Carlson's committee assignments as Civil Law and Procedure, Education, Retirement, and House Select Committee on Homeland Security, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, and Louisiana Rural Caucus.
